title: codex-run report
description: Pass to codex-run.sh -o to force codex's final message into the harness STATUS/CHANGED/VERIFY/NOTES contract (codex exec --output-schema). Every property is required and no extras are allowed, as OpenAI structured outputs demand.

status.description: DONE = task complete and verification passed; FAILED = could not complete; NEEDS_INPUT = blocked on a question for the orchestrator

changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files created, modified, or deleted (empty when none)

verify.description: The verification command run and its outcome (exit code + one-line summary), or 'n/a'

notes.description: Deviations from the spec, open questions, or an empty string
